programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc:
Pascal Brodnicki likes to explore the world through his sense of taste.He loves to prepare various dishes at street stalls, in African villages or on the beach. However, during his culinary journeys it was not always easy for him.Sometimes elephants stole his ingredients.Of course, Pascal couldn't deny himself the pleasure of tasting local delicacies.In Delhi, he stopped for a long time at a paratha stand, in a Zanzibar village he ate rice with coconut, and in Namibia he tried a zebra steak."Taste the world with Pascal" is not only about cooking.The host visited an elephant orphanage in Sri Lanka, fed cheetahs in Africa and climbed a coconut tree.In Bombay he became a teacher and taught Polish to children, and on the coast of Zanzibar he hunted octopus.Everywhere his passion and positive energy attracted crowds of onlookers
Pascal continues to explore the flavors of Sri Lanka - a country that is a leader in tea production.The cook decides to learn the secrets of working on the plantation.The appearance of an almost two-meter tall man will cause quite a sensation among the women working there.Pascal will also visit Negombo.The city on the west coast of the island is known mainly for its old market where you can buy various types of fish - from mackerel, through shark, to "flying fish".All fresh, straight from the sea.While exploring the coast, Pascal meets local fishermen.He offers them help, hoping that he will learn the secrets of preparing fish.However, it quickly turns out that he will have to prove himself as a trade fair seller.

programs.title: Africa Express
programs.desc:
For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship
Three pairs remain at the stadium in Sotik, and the competition changes the rules.Duos are split into chasers and players.Racers fight for survival: they look for transport, a place to sleep and face hunger.Players set out on a matatu with the leader, completing tasks whose results influence the fate of the chasers.Every mistake or success translates into difficulties or advantages for the partners.The first test is a quiz about the route so far, after which the chasers set off to Bomet, where they will face local challenges and convince a random passer-by to become their travel companion.During this time, players struggle with football tasks, fighting for further minutes of advantage.The final battle to get to the finals will be decided on the golf course at Sigona Golf Club.

programs.title: Travel patent
programs.desc: Artur Kot visits the Azores - an archipelago of nine islands in the Atlantic.He recommends spending no more than PLN 1,500 for this type of almost week-long trip - he will also tell you how to stick to the established budget.The traveler's route includes, among others:the volcanic island of Sao Miguel, the picturesque peaks of a crater surrounding two lakes and an abandoned five-star hotel.He hitchhikes deep into one of the islands - and once there, he has the opportunity to observe the celebration of a certain holiday.In the city of Furnas, Artur will see sulfur calderas, tea plantations and hot springs.

programs.title: Travel patent

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc:
In each episode of the program, Martyna Wojciechowska confirms that all women have their own extraordinary story.The traveler finds those that surprise the most by visiting the most remote corners of the world, including:in Bhutan, Nigeria, Papua, Russia and Colombia.Viewers meet 47-year-old Percy from the Philippines, a deeply religious Catholic who undergoes crucifixion during Easter.Filipinos consider it a form of penance for their sins.On the same continent lives Jyoti, who suffers from achondroplasia.The disease causes bone development disorders and dwarfism.Ashi Sonam Choden Dorji, from a royal family, lives in Bhutan.The team will check if she actually lives like a princess.The main character of the program will also be a woman from Sulawesi who died on July 1, 2014.Her story will be told by her sister, Yohana
Martyna and her team circled the Earth once again.She reached places she had never been before.She visited, among others:Bhutan - a mysterious kingdom in the Himalayas, where the happiest people in the world live, and in Papua she lived in one village with the Dani population.When traveling long distances, the simplest activities turn out to be a challenge.Viewers will learn how to wash their hair when the temperature does not exceed 10 degrees and how to attach a microphone when the interlocutor's only clothing is a gourd.The traveler will check how the heroines of her previous expeditions are doing.He will also reveal the secrets of creating such a unique program.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna goes to Saint Petersburg, where she will meet Larisa Renar, who runs the Academy of Private Life.Women can find answers to all their questions about women's and men's issues there.Over 150,000 students have already completed courses conducted by Larisa - not only from Russia, but also from China, England, the United Arab Emirates, Bulgaria and Turkey.The heroine of the episode completed her MBA;is a psychologist, motivational trainer, and author of eight guides for women.For Russian women, whose salary is 1/3 less than men's, marriage has not only a romantic aspect, but also a business one.Hence the popularity of Larissa Academy.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: 90% of Koreans use the Internet, almost all of them do it every day.There they follow vloggers who play online games, or muk-bang, i.e. people eating in front of the camera.Online users also adopt virtual children or see the world from a cat's perspective.However, greater activity on the Internet is related to the real, deepening loneliness of Koreans.The heroine of the episode will be BJ Levi, who reports her life on the Internet - she is Muk-bang and she makes money from it.In Korean, the word "family" means people who eat together.It is generally accepted that no one should eat a meal alone.On the other hand, nowadays more and more people live away from their families, so BJe provide them with company.The best of them can earn up to $9-10,000 a month, which is two or three times more than corporate employees.The most popular ones gain the status of celebrities.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits Malaysia.There he meets with members of the Badjao community, which the rest of the world has not yet heard of.According to legends, their ancestors had gills.Currently, these people can stay underwater for several minutes on one breath and dive to a depth of 20-30 meters without any specialized equipment.The Badjao live on boats or in houses built on stilts.They spend their whole lives there, so when they come ashore, they get land sickness.Their children learn to swim before they can even walk.The traveler visits a local healer, Djirajniha, who enjoys great trust and respect.Thanks to it, Martyna Wojciechowska can get to know the extraordinary world of Badjao.
